Cloud deployment platform Northflank says all users should assume their environment variables were decrypted and rotate every secret and credential now.

Per Northflank's status page (Oct 30, 2026):
• Rotate secrets on workloads, secret groups and global secrets immediately
• Disable public access to addons where enabled; secret rotation for Postgres and MongoDB addons is now enabled for all users
• Multiple users report their AI keys have been used
• Timeline: Wiz threat alert at 11:43 UTC, patching from 12:02 UTC, customer notice at 13:40 UTC; investigation ongoing

Customer Sentry says it rotated secrets and suspended deployments on Northflank, and has found no evidence its customer data or customer-facing services were affected.

🚨 WORDPRESS CORE RCE FLAW UNDER ATTACK HOURS AFTER PATCH (WordPress 7.1.4)

WordPress pushed 7.1.4 on Oct 28 as a security release and told admins to update immediately. Wordfence (Defiant) says attackers started trying to exploit one of the fixed bugs within hours.

• Race condition in WordPress Core's own update process, no login needed
• New files get unpacked into a predictable, web-reachable staging folder, which can lead to remote code execution
• Attack complexity is high: the window lasts only seconds, so attackers keep polling the staging paths
• No CVE assigned yet. Fixed in WordPress 7.1.4

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Ironically, the bug fires during an update. Make sure 7.1.4 is installed, and block web access to wp-content/upgrade where you can.

A threat actor has published a dataset of about 72,920 records said to come from the Cyprus government's Connectivity Grant (GigaVoucher) program for broadband subsidies.

The CSV allegedly includes:
* Beneficiary names and ID numbers
* Dates of birth
* Home addresses
* Phone numbers and email addresses
* Grant status and telecom provider details (including CYTA)

The data appears to date from 2025. The claim has not been independently verified.

⚠️ Analyst Note:
A list of grant recipients with IDs, birthdates and contact details is ready-made for fake "grant payment" or "voucher renewal" phishing. Cypriot residents should treat unsolicited GigaVoucher messages with suspicion. Unverified threat-actor claim, NOT confirmation of a breach.

🚨 CISA ADDS 2 MORE IVANTI CONNECT SECURE FLAWS TO KEV, EXPLOITED IN CHAIN (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527)

CISA added two more Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) VPN bugs to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog today, based on evidence of active exploitation. Both chain with CVE-2026-104935, the ICS zero-day added to KEV on Oct 13.

• CVE-2026-111357: missing authentication for a critical function, lets a local authenticated attacker escalate privileges
• CVE-2026-118527: predictable identifiers, lets an authenticated attacker upload attacker-controlled files to a known location on disk
• Federal (BOD 26-04) due dates: Nov 2 for CVE-2026-111357, Nov 13 for CVE-2026-118527

⚠️ Analyst Note:
Patching CVE-2026-104935 alone may not be the end of it. If your ICS appliance was exposed before patching, run Ivanti's Integrity Checker and hunt for unexpected files and privilege changes.
